films.name: Portra 400
films.desc: Kodak Portra 400: the most loved colour negative, warm, natural skin, soft greens, gentle contrast and bright, airy midtones.

films.name: Gold 200
films.desc: Kodak Gold 200: the classic consumer film, warm and golden with rich yellows, friendly skin and yellowish greens.

films.name: Kodachrome 64
films.desc: Kodak Kodachrome 64: the classic magazine slide film, deep reds and golden yellows, dark, rich blues, restrained greens and dense shadows.

films.name: Portra 800
films.desc: Kodak Portra 800: fast Portra for low light, warmer and richer than 400, with a touch more colour in the reds.

films.name: CineStill 800T
films.desc: CineStill 800T: tungsten-balanced cinema film for night and city lights; cool, teal-leaning colour with warm skin and glowing reds (no halation: add Glow yourself).

films.name: Ektar 100
films.desc: Kodak Ektar 100: the finest-grained colour negative, with saturated colour, bold reds, vivid greens and strong, clean blues.

films.name: Ultramax 400
films.desc: Kodak UltraMax 400: Kodak's affordable all-rounder, warm, saturated and punchy, with rich blues and good skin tones.

films.name: Pro 400H
films.desc: Fujicolor Pro 400H: the pastel wedding favourite, soft colour, airy highlights, pale skin, minty greens and cyan skies.

films.name: Velvia 50
films.desc: Fujichrome Velvia 50: the legendary landscape slide film, intense saturation, deep blues, lush greens and a hint of magenta.

films.name: Superia 400
films.desc: Fujicolor Superia X-Tra 400: the classic everyday Fuji film, green-leaning colour, magenta-ish reds, cyan skies and snappy contrast.

films.name: ColorPlus 200
films.desc: Kodak ColorPlus 200: the budget Kodak classic, warm and yellow-golden, softer and more muted than Gold, with a nostalgic snapshot feel.

films.name: CineStill 400D
films.desc: CineStill 400D: daylight cinema film for stills, soft and warm with pastel colour, glowing skin and gentle cyan skies (no halation).

films.name: Fuji C200
films.desc: Fujicolor C200: Fuji's everyday film, with cool greens and blues, slightly muted reds and a clear, airy look.

films.name: Ektachrome E100
films.desc: Kodak Ektachrome E100: clean, neutral slide colour with crisp contrast and deep, clear blue and cyan skies.

films.name: Reala 100
films.desc: Fujicolor Reala 100: fine-grained negative known for accurate, natural colour, clean greens and true skin.

films.name: Provia 100F
films.desc: Fujichrome Provia 100F: the finest-grained Provia, accurate colour, clean blue skies and crisp, natural contrast.

films.name: Vision3 250D
films.desc: Kodak Vision3 250D and 50D: modern daylight motion-picture negative, natural and very soft, with open shadows, gentle highlights and warm skin.

films.name: Fuji Eterna
films.desc: Fujicolor Eterna: Fuji's cinema negative, very muted and understated, soft contrast, open shadows and quiet cyan-green tones.

films.name: Astia 100F
films.desc: Fujichrome Astia 100F: Fuji's soft slide film for people, gentle contrast with accurate, delicate colour and clean skies.

films.name: Agfa Ultra 100
films.desc: Agfa Ultra Color 100: one of the most saturated colour negatives ever made, bold reds and blues with skin kept in check.

films.name: Fuji Provia
films.desc: Fujifilm's standard rendering, after Provia slide film: true-to-life colour and moderate contrast for almost anything.

films.name: Fuji Velvia
films.desc: Fujifilm's vivid mode, after Velvia: saturated greens and blues and strong contrast, made for landscapes.

films.name: Fuji Astia
films.desc: Fujifilm's soft mode, after Astia slide film: gentle contrast and flattering skin with clean, bright colour.

films.name: Classic Chrome
films.desc: Fujifilm's documentary look, inspired by mid-century magazine slides: muted colours, deep shadows and calm, cyan-leaning skies.

films.name: Classic Neg
films.desc: Fujifilm's look after Superia snapshots: hard contrast, muted colour, teal skies and greens, reds leaning magenta.

films.name: Pro Neg Hi
films.desc: Fujifilm's portrait negative look with a bit more punch: natural skin tones and moderate contrast.

films.name: Pro Neg Std
films.desc: Fujifilm's softest portrait look, after studio colour negative: low contrast, muted colour and smooth skin.

films.name: Eterna
films.desc: Fujifilm's cinema look, after Eterna motion-picture film: very low saturation, soft contrast and open shadows.

films.name: Reala Ace
films.desc: Fujifilm's faithful negative look, after Superia Reala: natural, accurate colour with crisp contrast.

films.name: Nostalgic Neg
films.desc: Fujifilm's 1970s-print look: amber warmth, rich skin in the shadows and gentle, soft contrast.

films.name: Velvia 100
films.desc: Fujichrome Velvia 100: very saturated slide film with strong reds and greens, a little calmer and warmer than Velvia 50.

films.name: Provia 400X
films.desc: Fujichrome Provia 400X: the last fast Provia, rich but natural colour with good highlight detail.

films.name: Sensia 100
films.desc: Fujichrome Sensia 100: Fuji's consumer slide film, close to Provia with slightly brighter, warmer colour.

films.name: Ektachrome VS
films.desc: Kodak Ektachrome 100VS: Ektachrome's Very Saturated version, warm, punchy colour and strong contrast.

films.name: EliteChrome 200
films.desc: Kodak Elite Chrome 200: consumer slide film with bright, cheerful colour and a slightly cool cast.

films.name: Kodachrome 25
films.desc: Kodak Kodachrome 25: rich, archival slide colour with deep reds, strong blues, restrained greens and fine detail.

films.name: Kodachrome 200
films.desc: Kodak Kodachrome 200: the fast Kodachrome, warmer and grittier, with Kodachrome's distinctive reds.

films.name: Agfa Precisa
films.desc: Agfa CT Precisa 100: slide film with vivid, slightly cool colour, strong blues and greens and crisp contrast.

films.name: Polachrome
films.desc: Polaroid Polachrome: instant 35 mm slide film, dense and contrasty with low, earthy saturation.

films.name: Portra 160
films.desc: Kodak Portra 160: the portrait standard, very natural skin, low contrast and smooth, gentle colour.

films.name: Pro Image 100
films.desc: Kodak Pro Image 100: Kodak's portrait film for hot, bright places, warm and natural with moderate saturation.

films.name: Kodacolor 100
films.desc: Kodak Kodacolor 100: Kodak's new fine-grained everyday film, the classic warm palette with yellow-leaning oranges and deep blues and greens.

films.name: Superia 200
films.desc: Fujicolor Superia 200: everyday consumer negative with Fuji's crisp greens, cyan skies and slightly cool tones.

films.name: Superia 800
films.desc: Fujicolor Superia 800: fast consumer negative with saturated colour, a green cast and slightly open shadows.

films.name: Superia 1600
films.desc: Fujicolor Superia 1600: Fuji's fastest consumer negative, cool and green-tinged night-time colour with lifted blacks.

films.name: Fujifilm 200
films.desc: Fujifilm 200: Fuji's current consumer film, close to Kodak Gold but softer, slightly warm with gentle colour.

films.name: Fuji 160C
films.desc: Fujicolor Pro 160C: a contrasty professional negative with richer colour than Fuji's portrait films.

films.name: Fuji 800Z
films.desc: Fujicolor Pro 800Z: fast portrait negative with flattering skin and natural, slightly cool colour in low light.

films.name: Agfa Vista 200
films.desc: Agfa Vista 200: an inexpensive consumer negative with punchy reds, cool greens and a nostalgic feel.

films.name: Lomo Color 400
films.desc: Lomography Color Negative 400: punchy, warm everyday film with saturated colour and a fun, lo-fi feel.

films.name: LomoChrome 92
films.desc: LomoChrome Color '92: Lomography's 90s-nostalgia film, faded and vintage with muted colour, strong blues and lifted shadows.

films.name: Phoenix 200
films.desc: Harman Phoenix 200: the new from-scratch British colour film; high contrast, strong warm reds and an experimental, vintage feel.

films.name: CineStill 50D
films.desc: CineStill 50D: fine-grained daylight cinema film with clean, cool-leaning colour and smooth highlights.

films.name: Candido 800
films.desc: Candido 800: cinema film re-spooled for stills, cool and soft with muted, slightly teal colour for night and mixed light.

films.name: FP-100C
films.desc: Fujifilm FP-100C peel-apart instant film: soft contrast, cool blue-greens and creamy, dreamy colour.

films.name: Polaroid 600
films.desc: Polaroid 600 colour film: warm, low-contrast instant colour with creamy highlights and soft, faded blacks.

films.name: Polaroid SX-70
films.desc: Polaroid SX-70 (Time Zero): the dreamy vintage instant look, warm and faded with muted greens and blues.

films.name: Instax Mini
films.desc: Fujifilm Instax Mini: bright, punchy credit-card instant prints with clean, slightly cool colour.

films.name: Kodak 2383
films.desc: Kodak Vision 2383: the standard cinema print film, the classic movie look with deep blacks, teal shadows and warm skin.

films.name: Kodak 2393
films.desc: Kodak Vision Premier 2393: premium cinema print film, deep blacks and rich but more neutral colour.

films.name: Fuji 3513
films.desc: Fujicolor Positive 3513DI: Fuji's cinema print film, softer and cooler than Kodak's, with a green-leaning palette.
